programme.title: Boris Berezovsky - Legato - World of the Piano
programme.desc: We live in the “renaissance of the piano”, as the New York Times put it in summer. A new generation has made the piano popular again: pianists with a passion for virtuosity and a willingness to expand their repertoire. In addition to the usual classics they perform formerly scorned works or they discover neglected composers. LEGATO is a series dedicated to presenting some of this new movement's most fascinating pianists - their individual approaches, their fresh ideas and their music. During this episode, the spotlights are on the Russian pianist Boris Berezovsky. He performs works by Medtner (Fairy Tales), Llywelyn (Mutata Consilia), Beethoven (Diabelli Variations), Godowsky (Alt Wien) en Liadov (Three Preludes).

programme.title: Berliner Philharmoniker - Discovering Masterpieces – Beethoven No. 5
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Ludwig van Beethoven’s ‘Symphony No. 5’ is discussed. The piece has the character of an appeal from the very start, when the four-note “fate” motif casts a spell on listeners. The German musicologist Armin Koch analyses the work, while the German Beethoven expert Wulf Konold illustrates the ingenious variations of the “fate” motif on piano, and also explains other features of this magnificent work.

programme.title: Lang Lang - Lang Lang – The Third Dimension
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Lang Lang performs some of the greatest works in the piano repertoire at Berghain in Berlin in 2010. The concert program includes the first movement of Piano Sonata No. 23, op. 57, called Beethoven's Appassionata, the precipato of Prokofiev's Sonata No. 7, and the mention of Iberia (Book 1), the masterpiece of Isaac Albéniz. Lang Lang closes the evening with a powerful version of the ''Heroic'' Polonaise, op. 53 from Chopin.

programme.title: Tom Beghin - Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 32, Op. 111
programme.desc: Can we get into Beethoven’s creative mind, especially in the last phase of his life, when he was coping with severe hearing loss? Tom Beghin’s new recording of Beethoven’s Piano Sonatas Opus 109, 110, and 111 is an artistic exploration of how Beethoven’s musicking was shaped by the work environment he created with the help of colleagues and friends. Not only does pianist Tom Beghin perform Beethoven’s trilogy of pianistic masterpieces on a magnificent new replica of Beethoven’s Broadwood piano, he uses a reconstruction of the Gehörmaschine that was mounted on the composer’s piano so he could continue to create music as his hearing declined. ‘You do hear better when you bring your head under this machine, don’t you?’ André Stein asked Beethoven. Two centuries later, we too can bring our heads under the machine and wonder: Do we hear Beethoven differently? Beghin draws us inside the hearing machine, where we feel as well as hear the essence of Beethoven’s rambunctious and irresistibly poetic musical vibrations. Inside the Hearing Machine invites us into the multisensory playground of a deaf composer for whom the machine was more than a hearing aid and who interacted with his instrument through much more than sound.

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: German Brass - German Brass goes Bach
programme.desc: The German Brass ensemble delivers some of Bach's most popular tunes in breathtaking brass arrangements. Recorded live from the magnificent St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, this concert features timeless pieces by the legendary German composer.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto And Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería - Saint-Saëns - The Carnival of the Animals
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Camille Saint-Saëns’s musical suite The Carnival of the Animals (Le carnaval des animaux, 1886). This suite consists of 14 movements, each depicting a different animal. The work was published posthumously in 1922, as Saint-Saëns was concerned that his animal miniatures, full of delightful jokes, might damage his reputation as a serious composer. Scored for cello and two pianos, ‘The Swan’ is the only movement that Saint-Saëns allowed to be published during his lifetime. This iconic movement features a beautiful flowing cello melody and gentle piano accompaniment, evoking the image of a swan gliding gracefully over the water. Each movement is introduced by Prieto. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Nacional in Mexico City, in 2021.

programme.title: Glass Marcano, Orchestre Symphonique Région Centre-Val de Loire/Tours And Stéphanie-Marie Degand - Beethoven Violin Concerto And Bizet Symphony in C
programme.desc: Young Venezuelan conductor Glass Marcano is a rising star. Having played in various local youth and symphony orchestras as a violinist, her first experience conducting an ensemble followed in 2012. In September 2020, she won the Orchestra Prize at La Maestra Competition – the first orchestra direction contest for women – held in Paris. In this concert, recorded at Opéra de Tours in February 2021, Marcano leads the Orchestre Symphonique Région Centre-Val de Loire/Tours in performances of two Romantic masterpieces. The program opens with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Violin Concerto in D major, Op. 61, featuring Stéphanie-Marie Degand as the soloist. This piece is one of the most important works in its genre. The program concludes with Georges Bizet’s 1855 Symphony in C major, written when the composer was only 17 years old.

programme.title: Enrico Pace - Bach - Sonata No. 1 BWV 1014
programme.desc: This Sonata for Violin and Harpsichord No. 1 BWV 1014 is the first of the set of sonatas Johann Sebastian Bach composed before 1725, probably during his time as chapel master in Köthen. Presumably, he wrote these sonatas for Prince Leopold and later adapted them for further use in Leipzig. Maybe this is why these pieces are well playable for amateurs, while every sonata still has the finesse that can offer a challenge to professional musicians. The different pieces are meant to be a set, just like the Brandenburg concertos.

programme.title: Charles Bélisle - Summertime at the Domaine Forget
programme.desc: The documentary Summertime at the Domaine Forget introduces internationally renowned treasure: Domaine Forget festival in Saint-Irénée, Québec. Domaine Forget is one of Canada's leading music academies and hosts this annual festival to promote music and dance. Every summer, 500 music students from around the world gather for an intensive course program featuring: masterclasses, individual lessons, chamber music sessions, lectures, and special workshops.

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwarz performs Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26 (Carnival Scenes from Vienna). Schumann composed most of the work during his stay in Vienna in 1839, where he wrote the first four movements, presenting pictures of lively carnival revelry. He completed the fifth, last movement on his return to Leipzig. This piano cycle is among the composer’s most popular. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto And Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería - Mahler - Symphony No. 8
programme.desc: In 2012, conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto and the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería released a critically acclaimed recording featuring violinist Philippe Quint. The Philippe Quint Plays Bruch, Mendelssohn and Beethoven album, recorded at Sala Nezahualcóyotl in Mexico City, showcased major classical concertos.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène - Beethoven - String Quartets No. 4, 5 And 12
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer’s complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 5 in A major, Op. 18, No. 5; String Quartet No. 4 in C minor, Op. 18, No. 4; and String Quartet No. 12 in E-flat major, Op. 127. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 17, 2020.

programme.title: Early Music Festival - England, my England - II
programme.desc: In episode 2 of this two-part documentary in line with the festival theme, René de Kam (Heritage Municipality of Utrecht) delves deeper into the Anglican past of the city of Utrecht.

programme.title: Henk de Graaf And Daniël Wayenberg - Brahms - Clarinet Sonata No. 2, Op. 120
programme.desc: Written in 1894, the two Clarinet Sonatas, Op. 120 are the last chamber music pieces Johannes Brahms composed. In this performance at Het Groene Paviljoen in Baarn, the Netherlands, clarinetist Henk de Graaf and pianist Daniël Wayenberg play Brahms’s Clarinet Sonata No. 2 in E-flat major, Op. 120.

programme.title: Martha Argerich And Eliane Reyes - Ravel - Ma mère l'Oye
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023. As part of this concert, pianists Martha Argerich and Khramouchin’s widow Eliane Reyes perform Maurice Ravel’s Ma mère l'Oye. This five-part suite was written for piano four hands.

programme.title: Magdalena Kožená, Sir Simon Rattle And Berliner Philharmoniker - Europakonzert 2013 - Prague
programme.desc: Every year since 1991, the Berliner Philharmoniker has given concerts in a different European city on each May 1st. These concerts have become known as ‘Europakonzert’. Every guest city has its own special cultural importance. These concerts have served two purposes: to commemorate the anniversary of the orchestra’s founding on May 1st, 1882, and to celebrate the common heritage of the Old World. In 1991, soon after the opening of the Eastern European countries, the first Europakonzert took place in the Czech Republic in Prague. This decision was a deliberate step and an expression of willingness to support and to bring forward the democratization and the political social changes, especially in the cultural area. In 1996 the Europakonzert took place once again in Prague (at the National Theatre). To continue this tradition the Europakonzert 2013 was celebrated at the Prague Castle at the historical Spanish Hall. Conductor: Sir Simon Rattle. Soloist: Magdalena Kozená. Works: Ralph Vaughan Williams, Fantasia on a Theme by Thomas Tallis, Antonín Dvořák, Ten Biblical Songs, Opus 99. Ludwig van Beethoven, Symphony No. 6 in F Major, Op. 68.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer And Budapest Festival Orchestra - Stravinsky - Jeu de cartes
programme.desc: Iván Fischer conducts the Budapest Festival Orchestra in a concert recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary in 2015. The concert opens with Sergei Prokofiev's Overture on Hebrew Themes, Op. 34. After this, Thomas Zehetmair stars as solo violinist in Prokofiev Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63. The second part of the concert is features music by Igor Stravinsky. On the program is music composed for the ballet 'Jeu de cartes' (1937) and the Firebird Suite, No. 2 (1919). 'Jeu de cartes' is one of Stravinsky's neo-classical works and consists of three parts ('deals'). The Firebird Suite, No. 2 is based on the music from the ballet of the same name, which was written for Sergei Diaghilev's Ballets Russes and premiered in Paris in 1910.

programme.title: Vadim Yarkov - Ice Dance: Nutcracker 2011
programme.desc: This stunning performance of theatrical ice dancing brings viewers into the enchanting world of Tchaikovsky's magnificent holiday classic, The Nutcracker On Ice, performed by the internationally renowned Imperial Ice Stars, and including former champion figure skaters, Vadim Yarkov and Olga Sharutenko. This very special performance and soundtrack was performed by the Manchester Symphony Orchestra, conducted by Tim A. Duncan, and filmed live in Cape Town, South Africa in 2011.

programme.title: amarcordplus And Sebastian Heindl - Baroque choral music by Bach, Schütz et al.
programme.desc: Five-strong vocal ensemble amarcord is joined by an extra alto and two soprano voices for this unusual concert at Leipzig’s St. Thomas Church. As amarcordplus, the ensemble presents a program focused on the city of Leipzig, which includes sacred madrigals by Johann Hermann Schein, motets from Heinrich Schütz’s collection Geistliche Chor-Music, as well as two motets by the most famous Thomaskantor: Johann Sebastian Bach. Moreover, various sacred works by lesser-known contemporaries Philipp Heinrich Erlebach and mononymous composer Liebhold are performed, in addition to compositions by other members of the Bach family, including Johann Michael Bach and Johann Christoph Bach. This performance was recorded on May 1, 2020.

programme.title: Antoine Tamistit And Robin Ticciati - Walton's Viola Concerto And Brahms's Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: British conductor Robin Ticciati conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of William Walton’s Viola Concerto and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98. Viola virtuoso Antoine Tamestit features as the soloist in Walton's Concerto. This concert, which unites youthful genius with music drawn from a profound engagement with life, was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s on Old Street in London, UK, on October 14, 2021.

programme.title: Paolo Belloli, Francesco Attesti And Italian OIDA Orchestra - Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 23, KV 488
programme.desc: Regarded as one of the finest interpreters of Romantic repertoire, Francesco Attesti (*1975) gave his first recital at age 11 and by the time he was 23, had earned the highest honours in piano from Florence’s Conservatorio Luigi Cherubini. In this recording of his 2016 Deeply Mozart concert tour, Attesti performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s piano concertos KV 449 and KV 488 with the Italian OIDA Orchestra and conductor Paolo Belloli.

programme.title: Gabriel Bebeselea - Weinberg - Rhapsody on Moldovan Themes, Op. 47/1
programme.desc: Over the course of 19 days, the best youth orchestras in the world led by great conductors, and flanked by virtuoso soloists, guaranteed exciting and inspiring concert performances at the Young Euro Classical 2017. The festival is known to be the most important platform for international young orchestra musicians in the European classical music tradition, and for its development. This highlight version is a collection of infectiously energizing and outstanding performances by musicians from across the globe. Their repertoire includes renowned classical works as well as local composers. On the program: Verdi - La forza del destino, Beethoven - Meeresstille und glückliche Fahrt, Tchaikovsky - Piano Concerto No. 1, Tchaikovsky - Six Romances, Kohji - Georgian, Mingrelian Songs, Weinberg - Rhapsody on Moldavian Themes Op. 47 and Wong - As the Heart Soars.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst And Cleveland Orchestra - Bruckner - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Bruckner's Symphony No. 7. The work occupies a singularly important place in the composer's output. It was with this piece that Bruckner finally achieved widespread recognition and it has remained one of his most popular works. The symphony adheres to the classical four-movement format. The heart of the work is a long and deeply felt Adagio, composed as a memorial to Wagner. The first movement begins with a soaring theme announced by cellos. The Scherzo relieves the somber atmosphere of the preceding Adagio and the Finale concludes the symphony on a note of unrestrained joy. Recorded in Severance Hall, Cleveland in 2008.

programme.title: Claudio Abbado, Lucerne Festival Orchestra And Magdalena Kožená - Abbado conducts Mahler No. 4 and Rückert-Lieder
programme.desc: Mezzo soprano Magdalena Kožená does not only make the heavenly joys resound in the final movement of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 4, earlier in the concert, she devotes herself to the seraphic beauty and intimate simplicity of Mahler’s Rückert Lieder. Practically all songs that Mahler composed prior to 1900 were based on texts from Des Knaben Wunderhorn, a collection of folk poems published by Clemens Brentano and Achim von Arnim. Since then, Mahler turned exclusively towards one single poet, the Franconian orientalist and translator Friedrich Rückert. Mahler acknowledged that the poems moved him so deeply that he sometimes felt he had written them himself. In the transcendent final Lied, Ich bin der Welt abhanden gekommen, he also quoted a phrase from the Adagio of his fourth symphony. Asked what it meant, he replied that it personifies himself.

programme.title: Tom Beghin - Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 30, Op. 109
programme.desc: Can we get into Beethoven’s creative mind, especially in the last phase of his life, when he was coping with severe hearing loss? Tom Beghin’s new recording of Beethoven’s Piano Sonatas Opus 109, 110, and 111 is an artistic exploration of how Beethoven’s musicking was shaped by the work environment he created with the help of colleagues and friends. Not only does pianist Tom Beghin perform Beethoven’s trilogy of pianistic masterpieces on a magnificent new replica of Beethoven’s Broadwood piano, he uses a reconstruction of the Gehörmaschine that was mounted on the composer’s piano so he could continue to create music as his hearing declined. ‘You do hear better when you bring your head under this machine, don’t you?’ André Stein asked Beethoven. Two centuries later, we too can bring our heads under the machine and wonder: Do we hear Beethoven differently? Beghin draws us inside the hearing machine, where we feel as well as hear the essence of Beethoven’s rambunctious and irresistibly poetic musical vibrations. Inside the Hearing Machine invites us into the multisensory playground of a deaf composer for whom the machine was more than a hearing aid and who interacted with his instrument through much more than sound.

programme.title: Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra - Brahms - Double Concerto in A minor, Op. 102
programme.desc: The 2007 Europa-Konzert takes place in Berlin, on the occasion of the 125th anniversary of the Berliner Philharmoniker. Under the theme The Year 1882, the acclaimed orchestra is lead by conductor Sir Simon Rattle as it interprets Brahms’ “Concerto for violin, cello and orchestra”, his Fourth Symphony and Wagners’ “Prelude to Act I” from Parsifal - the piece that marked the orchestra's first recorded work of September 1913 under the baton of Alfred Hertz. The soloists are Lisa Batiashvili (violin) and Truls Mørk (cello), established as sought-after young virtuosos and appearing regularly with leading orchestras and in recitals throughout the world. The “Kraftwerk und Kabelwerk Oberspree (power and cable factory)”, the remarkable venue of this concert, is one of the most impressive historical industrial building from the late 19th century in Berlin. As its impressive presence is infused with Brahms and Wagner, there is an air of total commitment, only enhanced further by the unusual surroundings. The collaboration of Lisa Batiashvili and Truls Mørk ensures a moving performance of Brahms’s last orchestral work, his Double Concerto. Following this, Rattle and the orchestra continue to demonstrate their outstanding musicianship, delivering Wagner's amazingly fresh and dynamic Fourth Symphony.

programme.title: Claudio Abbado, Berliner Philharmoniker, Eric Ericson Chamber Choir And Swedish Radio Choir - Beethoven - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Beethoven's Symphony no 9 is interpreted by the Berlin Philharmonic under former chief conductor Claudio Abbado at the Berliner Philharmonie in 2001. The recording features interpretations that are the fruit of decades of Claudio Abbado’s involvement with Beethoven. Listening to the music, one hears how the Berlin Philharmonic transforms Abbado’s musical intentions into sound – there is a sense of unity that can only be achieved through many years of shared artistic experience and attention to detail.

programme.title: John Cage - How to get out of the Cage - A year with John Cage
programme.desc: The compelling documentary How to Get Out of the Cage (2012) by award-winning filmmaker Frank Scheffer presents an intimate portrait of John Cage (1912-1992), one of 20th century's most important composers. From 1982 to 1992, Scheffer worked with Cage on numerous occasions, which resulted in unique archives of historical audio-visual material, including interviews, musical performances, and images of locations related to the composer’s life and work. In all Scheffer’s works related to Cage, he used the old Chinese method of chance operations based on the Yi Jing – as often used by Cage himself in his compositions. Instead of using chance operations, Scheffer edited the film in the usual way that is based on choice.

programme.title: OPERA2DAY, New European Ensemble, Quirijn de Lang And Lucie Chartin - Thomas - Hamlet
programme.desc: Hamlet is a grand opera in five acts by the French composer Ambroise Thomas (1811-1896), with a libretto by Michel Carré and Jules Barbier. It is based on a French adaptation by Alexandre Dumas and Paul Meurice of Shakespeare's Hamlet. Thomas’ operas Mignon (1866) and Hamlet (1868) were largely neglected during the 20th century but experienced somewhat of a revival over the last decades. In this performance, staged by Serge van Veggel, The New European Ensemble is led by conductor Hernán Schvartzman. Main soloists are Quirijn de Lang (Hamlet), Lucie Chartin (Ophélie), Martijn Sanders (Claudius), Martina Prins (Gertrude), Jan-Willem Schaafsma (Laertes), and Patrick Pranger (Horatio). This performance was recorded at the Royal Theatre in The Hague, in April 2018.

programme.title: Micah McLaurin - PIAM - Semi-final I: Chopin and Scriabin
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano. As part of this competition, Micah McLaurin (USA, 1994) performs Frédéric Chopin’s Nocturne Op. 27 No. 2, and Barcarolle, Op. 60; and a selection of Alexander Scriabin’s Etudes: Op. 42 No. 5, and Op. 8 Nos. 11 and 12. This performance was recorded at Teatro EDI Barrio’s in Milan, in January 2020.

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Zoltán Kocsis, Jiri Belohlavek And Virtuosi de Praha - Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 23 in A major
programme.desc: Zoltán Kocsis (1952-2016) performs Mozart’s Piano Concerto No. 23, KV 488. The Virtuosi de Praha are conducted by Jirí Belohlávek in a concert that took place in Prague in 1999. Mozart completed the concerto on March 2, 1786, around the time his Le nozze di Figaro premiered. The final rondo puts Mozart’s musical humour on full display. Themes are tossed back and forth between the soloist and orchestra as they chase each other through unexpected key changes.

programme.title: Václav Luks And Collegium 1704 - Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach’s Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. In this performance at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany, Luks and his Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 4 in G major, BWV 1049. This concerto features solos from two recorders and a violin. The recorders play a prominent role in the concerto’s second movement, while the violin dominates the fast first and third movements.

programme.title: Leonardo García Alarcón, Cappella Mediterranea And Mariana Flores - Vocal baroque works by Cavalli, Strozzi And Bembo
programme.desc: Argentinian conductor and harpsichordist Leonardo García Alarcón leads his ensemble Cappella Mediterranea in a program of Italian Baroque music. The ensemble performs some of the finest Baroque pieces composed by Francesco Cavalli, a prominent composer in 17th-century Venice, and two of his famous students, Barbara Strozzi and Antonia Bembo.

programme.title: Leonidas Kavakos And Yuja Wang - Brahms - Violin Sonata No. 3, Op. 108
programme.desc: In this splendid 2013 concert from the Church of Verbier, Switzerland, Greek violinist Leonidas Kavakos and Chinese pianist Yuja Wang join forces to interpret three sonatas by Johannes Brahms. Leonidas Kavakos rose to fame in 1985, when he became the youngest musician to ever win the first price of the prestigious Sibelius Competition. With Yuja Wang, an accomplished artist at young age herself, he forms a masterful duo of chamber music interpretation. The programme features Brahm's Sonata for Piano and Violin, No. 1 in G major, Op. 78, also known as the Regensonate, Sonata for Piano and Violin, No. 2 in A major, Op. 100, the Thuner Sonata, a portrait of the Swiss lake of Thun's peaceful scenery. It comes to a fiery and passionate finale with Brahm's Sonata for Piano and Violin, No. 3 in D minor, Op 108.

programme.title: Olivier Latry - In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally. He sees himself as an ambassador of French music from the 17th through the 20th centuries as well as an advocate for the art of improvisation. Pieces played in the film are: Pierre Cochereau’s Boléro, Louis Vierne’s Carillon of Westminster and Scherzo from Symphony No. 2, Alexandre Guilmant’s Sonata No. 1, Charles-Marie Widor’s Gothic Symphony, Marcel Dupre’s Cortège, Litanie and J. S. Bach’s Passacaille And Fugue.

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 3, Op. 14
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birthday, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. The Third Piano Sonata, Op. 14 (also called Concerto for piano without orchestra by Tobias Haslinger) was composed in 1836 and dedicated to Ignaz Moscheles. In 1853 Schumann revised the work and added a Scherzo as a second movement. The final movement is reminiscent of Kreisleriana, Op. 16. Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has had the privilege of performing as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, among them Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: Krzysztof Michalski - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Roberto Prosseda, Steven Isserlis And Ian Bostridge - Patmos – A musical documentary
programme.desc: Every summer, the Greek island of Patmos hosts the Patmos Musical Festival, a unique musical event comprising both a Chamber and a Sacred Music Festival. This documentary captures the 2024 edition, featuring performances by distinguished soloists and ensembles from around the world.

programme.title: Marco Sollini And Salvatore Barbatano - Liszt - Due Poemi Sinfonici
programme.desc: Franz Liszt (1811 - 1886) composed 13 symphonic poems, largely inspired by literary texts. The composer himself wrote piano duet arrangements for these pieces, showcasing his incredible ability of imitating a full orchestra on the piano. Liszt, one of the 19th century’s most important piano virtuosos, strongly influenced the further development of piano music. The Romantic period was the era of the virtuoso pianists: the piano was the instrument of choice for countless musicians and listeners alike. No house of standing could do without a piano: it was a status symbol. Piano music was played in concert halls, palaces, salons, churches and public houses alike. Liszt’s symphonic poem no. 4, ‘Orpheus’, breathes a meditative atmosphere. No. 3, ‘Les Préludes’, is best known in its symphonic version – the piano version presented here is rarely heard. The work dates back to the period 1848 – 1854 and was initially meant to serve as introduction to a choral cycle to be based on the texts of the poet Joseph Autran, ‘Les quatre éléments’: earth, air, water and fire. In this broadcast, the Italian piano duo of Marco Sollini and Salvatore Barbatano performs these Liszt piano works. These recordings were made at the beautiful 12th century church of San Marco in the small but picturesque village of Ponzano di Fermo, as part of the 2015 edition of the annual, itinerant festival ‘Armonie della sera’ in the Italian province of Le Marche.

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt - Mozart - Symphony No. 38, K. 504
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig’s Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek’s Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Although the composition – Voríšek’s only symphony – was never performed during the composer’s lifetime, it has become one of his most-performed works today.

programme.title: Vadim Repin And Murad Huseynov - Gara Garayev : Autumn Sonatas
programme.desc: Pianist Vadim Repin and Violist Murad Hüseynov perform Gara Garayev's Violin Sonata and 24 Preludes for Piano. Recorded at La Grange ay Lac. Written and directed by Juliette Swierczewski and recorded at La Grange au Lac. Although Garayev is a 20th century composer, his music nonetheless carries allusions to romantic music. Murad, the main actor, will represent one of those characters carried by solitude that can be found in the romantic paintings of Friedrich. The overall atmosphere of the musical program is rather melancholic, tending either towards a certain musical lightness, or, on the contrary, towards drama. The production is a cinematographic accompaniment of the music and its performers.

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Novelletten, Op. 21
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Novelletten, Op. 21. The eight pieces for piano that make up this song cycle are often performed separately. It bears a dedication to pianist Adolph Henselt. Schumann composed the pieces between January and April of 1838, around the same time as Kinderszenen, Op. 18, and Kreisleriana, Op. 16. Novelletten is the most substantial yet least-known of Schumann’s piano cycles. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: Hyung-ki Joo, Aleksey Igudesman, Bergen Philharmonic Orchestra And Andrew Litton - Big Nightmare Music
programme.desc: In “Big Nightmare Music”, Aleksey Igudesman and Hyung-ki Joo perform their unique interpretations of classical favorites next to several sketches, tailor-made for a symphony orchestra. Their 2017 performance at Grieghallen in Bergen, Norway, is conducted by Andrew Litton.

programme.title: Cleveland Orchestra And Franz Welser-Möst - Bruckner - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: When it comes to shaping a musical event for the ears and the eyes, the monumental majesty of Anton Bruckner’s (1824-1896) symphonies and the exhilarating vibrancy of St. Florian’s monastery are a perfect match – especially when they are captured on film so thrillingly by such an eminent director as Brian Large in 2012. Bruckner became acquainted with the monastery’s organ in his childhood and served as the organist there from 1845 to 1855. Welser-Möst, the principal conductor of the Cleveland Orchestra and General Music Director of the Vienna State Opera, is an acknowledged Bruckner specialist who has developed a passion for the composer’s Fourth Symphony – called the “Romantic” by its creator – in its infrequently played first edition (1888/89). More slender, dynamic and finely shaded than the more commonly performed version, this score is also more daring, with its sharper contrasts and boldly exposed dissonances. Recorded at the St. Florian Monastery in Austria, in 2012.

programme.title: Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch, Danish National Symphony Orchestra And Emma Smith - The Babylon Hotel
programme.desc: Nur eine Nacht! Willkommen in der spektakulären und dekadenten Welt des Babylon Hotel, wo Musik aus jeder Ecke wie sprudelnder Champagner fließt. In diesem Konzert trifft die Oberschicht auf die Unterwelt in einer Mischung aus Euphorie und Extravaganz, Nostalgie und Vergnügen, mit einer sorglosen Sündhaftigkeit, wie man sie nur im überschwänglichen Nachtleben der 1920er Jahre weltweit findet. Das Konzert präsentiert ikonische Musik aus Filmen und Serien wie The Great Gatsby, Burlesque und Babylon Berlin. Die Musik wird vom Danish National Symphony Orchestra und dem DR Big Band unter der Leitung von Miho Hazama aufgeführt. Das Konzert präsentiert auch das Moka Efti Orchestra sowie die Sänger Madame le Pustra, Emma Smith, Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch und Nikko Weidemann, begleitet von den Tänzern der Sweet Burlesque. Diese Aufführung wurde im Mai 2023 im DR Koncerthuset in Kopenhagen, Dänemark, aufgezeichnet.

programme.title: Roberto Prosseda - Mozart - Piano Sonata No. 5, KV 283
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn. Since 2012, Prosseda also gives lecture-concerts with the robot pianist TeoTronico, as educational or family concerts, to demonstrate differences between a literal production of music and human interpretation.

programme.title: Yannick Nézet-Séguin - Dvořák - Violin Concerto in A minor, Op. 53
programme.desc: For the 2016 edition of the Waldbühne, the Georgian violinist Lisa Batiashvili and the Québécois conductor Yannick Nézet-Séguin join the Berliner Philharmoniker for a beautiful concert. They present an all Czech program! We always think of Germany, Austria, and Italy when we name great classical composers, but the Czech Republic also delivered some master composers such as Antonin Dvorák, Bedrich Smetana, Leos Janacek, and Bohuslav Martinu. This concert starts with Smetana’s famous Vltava from Má Vlast. Lisa Batiashvili plays Dvorák’s Violin Concerto in A minor, and the concerts centerpiece is Dvorák’s Symphony No. 6.

programme.title: London Symphony Orchestra, Gianandrea Noseda, Roman Simovic And David Cohen - Triple Concerto, Op. 56 And Symphonie Fantastique
programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the combined forces of the Music Academy KestonMAX fellows and London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Ludwig van Beethoven’s Triple Concerto in C major, Op. 56, and Hector Berlioz’s Symphonie Fantastique, Op. 14. This concert was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s in London, UK, on November 20, 2022.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan And Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris - Beethoven - Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93. Beethoven wrote the work in 1812 upon completion of his Symphony No. 7. The composer conducted the February 27, 1814 première at a concert in Vienna that also included a reprise performance of his Symphony No. 7 and his 15-minute orchestral piece Wellington’s Victory, Op. 91. The shortest of Beethoven’s nine symphonies, Symphony No. 8 lacks a truly slow movement. Instead it has a second movement, Allegretto scherzando, that features a steady ‘ticking’ rhythm maintained by the woodwinds throughout the movement. This is thought to be an imitation of the Andante movement of Joseph Haydn’s ‘Clock’ Symphony. Jordan’s performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: David Grimal - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Simon Rattle - Mahler - Symphony No. 6
programme.desc: On November 14, 1987, a promising conductor made his Berlin Philharmonic debut with Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 6: Simon Rattle. In retrospect Rattle says, “I felt that I was finding my voice on that day.” Mahler’s multifaceted work is now again on the program when Sir Simon appears for the last time as chief conductor of the Berliner Philharmoniker in the Philharmonie in 2018. The wheel comes full circle. Mahler's Symphony No. 6 is often referred to by the nickname Tragische (Tragic). Mahler composed work during a happy time in his life, as he had married his wife Alma in 1902 and became father of his second daughter. This contrasts with the tragic and even nihilistic last movement of the symphony.

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt And Lucerne Festival Orchestra - Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Alexander Ullman - Liszt - Piano Concerto No. 2, S.125
programme.desc: Alexander Ullman (1991, United Kingdom) performs Franz Liszt's Piano Concerto No. 2 (S125) during the final of the 11th International Franz Liszt Piano Competition, held in TivoliVredenburg, Utrecht 2017. The competition actively presents, develops and promotes piano talents from around the world. In doing so, it has become one of the prominent gateways to the international professional classical music scene for young musicians. The International Franz Liszt Piano Competition was founded in 1986 in the Netherlands and since has built a reputation as one of the world’s most prestigious piano competitions.

programme.title: Lydia Teuscher , Gunther Emmerlich , Bo Skovhus And Petra-Maria Schnitzer - Lehár - The Merry Widow
programme.desc: Paris, the city of love (and loose morals) is an excellent setting for an operetta, Franz Lehár must have thought when he was composing Die Lustige Witwe. Widow Hanna Glawari is perversely rich. The ambassador of the poverty-stricken Grand Duchy of Pontevedro wants to avoid that her money ends up in foreign hands, and means to find Hanna a suitable husband. He thinks that Count Danilo Danilovitsch, who had already had his eye on Hanna before her first marriage, fits his profile. Back in the day, the Count could not marry her, as she had nothing to her name. Now he is hesitant to proclaim his love to her, out of fear that she might think it is her 20 million he is after... Recorded in the Semperoper in Dresden in 2008, featuring Gunter Emmerlich, Bo Skovhus and Petra Maria Schnitzer.

programme.title: Pierre-Laurent Aimard - Legato - World of the Piano
programme.desc: We live in the renaissance of the piano. Musicians with a passion for virtuosity and a willingness to expand their repertoire have made the piano popular again. In addition to the usual classics they perform formerly scorned works or they discover neglected composers. Legato is a series dedicated to four fascinating pianists - their individual approaches, their fresh ideas and their music. Today in the focus: Pierre-Laurent Aimard, the French specialist for classical and avantgarde music. Johann Sebastian Bach: The Art of the Fugue BWV 1080, Nos. 4, 10, 12, 14; Elliott Carter: Matribute, Two Diversions; George Benjamin: Shadowlines I - VI; Ludwig van Beethoven: Sonata in A flat Major, Op. 110.

programme.title: Touring Club Italiano - Teatro Regio behind the scenes
programme.desc: Few Italian theatres can boast of being an absolute point of reference for national and world culture. The Teatro Regio in Turin is both a symbol of excellence in the national operatic tradition and a prestigious stage hosting operas, ballets, concerts, and musicals of great substance. This short documentary offers a behind-the-scenes tour of the Teatro Regio Torino and bears witness to the enviable reputation that has prevailed since its opening in 1740.

programme.title: Gewandhausorchester, Andris Nelsons And Baiba Skride - Shostakovich - Violin Concerto No. 1, Op. 77
programme.desc: In May 2019, the new principal conductor of the Gewandhaus, Andris Nelsons, presented Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 5 with his orchestra in combination with Shostakovich’s Violin Concerto No. 1 with outstanding violinist Baiba Skride as the soloist. In this composition, the violin does not allow itself a break, continually tells its dark story and gets into a vicious circle of ostinato Passacaglia bass lines again and again falls into beguilingly beautiful singing. Tchaikovsky initially thought his 'Symphony of Fate' was a failure and believed himself to be at the end of his creative powers. It was probably the composer's nature, plagued by self-doubt, that made it almost impossible for him to develop a self-confident attitude to his own creative power. Between this two works, Skride performs Stravinsky's Elegy for Solo Violin.

programme.title: Ying Li - PIAM - Semi-final II: Mozart and Bartók
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano. As part of this competition, Ying Li (China, 1997) performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Sonata No. 13 in B-flat major, K. 333, and Béla Bartók’s Sonata, BB 88, Sz.80. This performance was recorded at Nuovo Teatro Ariberto in Milan, in June 2021.

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Itzhak Perlman, Daniel Barenboim And Berliner Philharmoniker - Beethoven - Violin Concerto in D major, Op. 61
programme.desc: Israeli violinist Itzhak Perlman and the Berlin Philharmonic perform the Violin Concerto, Op. 61 by Ludwig van Beethoven under the direction of Daniel Barenboim. Beethoven dedicated his Violin Concerto to his colleague Franz Clement, a prominent violinist of the time. The first of the piece was presented in Vienna in 1806. The piece was only interpreted a handful of times during the following decades. However, the work took a new lease of life in 1844, when the young violinist Joseph Joachim, barely 12 years old, performed with the London Philharmonic Society, under the direction of Mendelssohn. Since then, Beethoven's Violin Concerto has been one of the most important concertos in the classical repertoire. This work, renowned for its wide range of cadenzas, poses a great technical and intellectual challenge, brilliantly picked up by Perlman and the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer And Budapest Festival Orchestra - Stravinsky: Firebird Suite No. 2
programme.desc: Iván Fischer conducts the Budapest Festival Orchestra in a concert recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary in 2015. The concert opens with Sergei Prokofiev's Overture on Hebrew Themes, Op. 34. After this, Thomas Zehetmair stars as solo violinist in Prokofiev Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63. The second part of the concert is features music by Igor Stravinsky. On the program is music composed for the ballet 'Jeu de cartes' (1937) and the Firebird Suite, No. 2 (1919). 'Jeu de cartes' is one of Stravinsky's neo-classical works and consists of three parts ('deals'). The Firebird Suite, No. 2 is based on the music from the ballet of the same name, which was written for Sergei Diaghilev's Ballets Russes and premiered in Paris in 1910.

En förändring som införs när den unge kungen Carl XVI Gustaf tar över. Under femtio år har han nu regerat som den mest maktlöse kungen i Europa. Monarkin har reducerats till ett sagoslott.

programme.title: Hjälp, vi har köpt ett franskt ruckel!
programme.desc: Kalle fortsätter arbetet med kökets planlösning, vilket tyvärr innebär ett hot för det återbrukade klinkergolvet. Familjen får glada besked från borgmästaren, och Brita lär av en slump känna en granne som sätter personlig prägel på hallen. Allt verkar flyta på - tills ett kraftigt oväder plötsligt sveper in över byn. Är en ny catastrophe de caca på gång? 5 av 6.

programme.title: Alexandra - syns vi inte, finns vi inte
programme.desc: Motgångar, dödsfall i familjen och ekonomiska svårigheter sätter djupa spår i Alexandras liv. Samtidigt finner hon ny mening genom en ny stor kärlek och arbetet för kvinnors hälsa. I takt med att synen försämras blir minnena allt starkare, och händelser från barndomen - länge förträngda - gör sig påminda. Gradvis träder personen Lill fram, medan den offentliga figuren Alexandra tonas ned. Kvar finns berättelsen om vem Alexandra ”Lill” Charles von Hofsten egentligen är.

programme.title: Svenska designklassiker
programme.desc: Stringhyllan hängdes upp i varje modernt hem under 1950-talet. Men succén var sprungen en annan framgång, diskstället, skapat några år tidigare för radikala husmödrar som ville göra annat än att torka disk. Formgivarna Nils och Kajsa Strinning la helt enkelt bräder på diskstället, och vips skapades bokhyllan String.

programme.title: Förbjuden ingång
programme.desc: En dramakomedi om en grupp unga kvinnor som bor tillsammans i ett pensionat i New York, alla med drömmar om att lyckas på Broadway. När den ambitiösa Terry Randall anländer, uppstår både vänskap och rivalitet bland de aspirerande skådespelerskorna.

programme.title: Jills veranda, Nashville
programme.desc: Det traditionstyngda och konservativa Nashville prövas när Kakan Hermansson, lesbisk feminist, besöker Jill och provar på livet hemma hos en av ledarna för den lokala Tea Party-rörelsen.

programme.title: Sveriges sista kungar
programme.desc: Gustaf VI Adolf har rollen som regeringsbildare och högste befälhavare men först under hans tid som monark fattas beslutet att ändra grundlagen till att folket styr riket. En förändring som införs när den unge kungen Carl XVI Gustaf tar över. Under femtio år har han nu regerat som den mest maktlöse kungen i Europa. Monarkin har reducerats till ett sagoslott.

programme.title: Sverige Live

Programledare: Farah Abadi och Jovan Radomir.

Här kommer årets största värderingar, de mest oväntade fynden och de roligaste mötena - allt samlat i det bäsa Antikrundan! Vi återser några av årets höjdpunkter och får ladda upp inför att Antikrundan snart ger sig ut på ny turné runt Sverige. Denna säsong besöktes Hässleholm, Huskvarna, Vänersborg, Botkyrka, Bollnäs och Härnösand.

programme.title: Guds gäng
programme.desc: Sebastians nya liv kretsar kring kallet han fått från Jesus - att hjälpa de utsatta i samhället. Han driver sin egen hjälp- och väckelseorganisation och jobbar med barndomsvännerna Flavia, Betz och René. Han har även starkt stöd från inflytelserika personer inom väckelserörelsen. Gängvåldet som drabbar Sveriges barn föder en idé att göra något ännu större och viktigare. Men det visar sig ha ett mycket högt pris.

programme.title: Sometimes I think about dying
programme.desc: Fran, som gillar att tänka på döden, får den nya killen på jobbet att skratta, vilket leder till dejtande och mer därtill. Nu är det bara Fran själv som står i vägen för deras kärlek.

programme.title: Svärtan
programme.desc: Särsö samlas för den årliga festen till havets ära, men efter Dannes död är det långt ifrån alla som känner tacksamhet. Medan gamla konflikter blossar upp under festkvällen dras Johannes allt djupare in i besattheten av sjöjungfrun. När han ser hur Helena påverkas av hennes krafter växer Johannes oro, och till slut tvingas han fatta ett avgörande beslut. fl. Del 4 av 6.

programme.title: I seriemördarens samling
programme.desc: Ett namn återkommer i arkiven som leder polisens utredare ett stort steg närmare sanningen - men som samtidigt ska komma att skaka poliskåren i grunden. Hur mycket visste David Torres egentligen? Och hur kunde Bruce Lindahl gå fri trots alla överväldigande bevis?

programme.title: Hemmagympa med Sofia
programme.desc: Sofia Åhman leder SVT:s hemmagympapass. Denna gång är temat styrka/kondition.

programme.title: Stoltenberg
programme.desc: Sverige och Finland överger sin alliansfrihet och ansöker om medlemskap i Nato. Men Turkiet bestämmer sig för att blockera Sverige. Jens Stoltenberg och hans rådgivare får ta till sina allra bästa diplomatiska tricks för att få president Erdoǧan att ändra sig. En febril aktivitet sker bortom mediernas bevakning.

programme.title: Sveriges sista kungar
programme.desc: Gustaf V tar över i en tid när kungen styr riket. Demokrati, allmän rösträtt och parlamentarism är ännu inte infört i Sverige. Han är den siste svenske kungen som söker politisk makt och han medverkar aktivt för att hålla Sverige utanför världskrigen, trots sin tyskvänlighet. Under andra världskriget hyllar han Hitlers anfall på Sovjetunionen.

programme.title: Svenska tv-historier
programme.desc: Gladhopp med pop, kniiip och ta det lugnt. På varierande sätt har olika tv-program genom tiderna försökt inspirera tittarna till att komma igång och träna.

programme.title: På resa med Bachstad i Afrika
programme.desc: Rune och Øystein kommer riktigt nära Afrikas stora djur, samtidigt som de får en snabbkurs i det politiska ledarskap som blev Botswanas stora lycka och formade landets framtid.

programme.title: Kulturtanter på resa
programme.desc: Resan går vidare till Istanbul, där kulturdamerna provar lammhjärns-paté och lockas av storstadens myllrande basarer. De fascineras av de detaljrika utsmyckningarna i en av stadens många moskéer och kastas mellan historia och nutid i den turkiska metropolen.

programme.title: Barnmorskan i East End - julspecial
programme.desc: Förlängd julspecial från 2023. Jul 1968. Samtidigt som astronauter ger sig ut i rymden fortsätter livet på Nonnatus House. Syster Monica Joan är övertygad om att detta blir hennes sista jul och att hon inte kommer att få uppleva människan gå på månen. Trixie och Matthew förbereder sig för sin första jul som gifta när Trixies bror Geoffrey gör ett oväntat besök. I rollerna: Jenny Agutter, Linda Bassett, Judy Parfitt, Ella Bruccoleri, Helen George, Laura Main, m.fl.

Snart har företaget kammat hem närmare tre miljoner kronor utan att de verkar ha gjort ett enda jobb. Kan det verkligen vara så lätt att fuska med våra skattpengar? Uppdrag gransknings reporter bestämmer sig för att testa hur bra kontrollerna fungerar.

programme.title: Sverige, krisen och jag

Han träffar bland annat survivalisten Richard Gustafsson och Misse Wester, professor i riskhantering och samhällssäkerhet.

programme.desc: För cirkusdirektören Trolle Rhodin och många i hans cirkussällskap är den rörliga och resande livsstilen en självklarhet där gemenskapen är central. Tanja Hagert i Luleå berättar varför hennes klänningar är en så viktig del av hennes finsk-romska kultur. Stephan Skougard Carlsson om att bara vilja passa in som barn. Dessutom sång med Hans Caldaras.

programme.title: Diagnosernas kraft: adhd och dyslexi
programme.desc: Chris Packham undersöker hur det är att leva med dyslexi och varför diagnosen fortfarande omges av missförstånd. Med hjälp av filmskapare, animatörer och grafiska formgivare skapas kreativa berättelser där två personer beskriver hur dyslexin påverkar deras vardag.

programme.title: OS i överlevnad: Alone Australien
programme.desc: Utmaningens tio deltagare har noga tänkt igenom sina överlevnadsstrategier. Vilken utrustning de valt, hur de ska skaffa mat och bygga skydd. Både Mike och Gina har gått upp 19kg som en del av förberedelserna. Är det extra kilon, eller något helt annat som blir den avgörande faktorn i vem av de tio som står som vinnare i Alone Australien säsong 1? Del 4 av 13.

programme.title: Världens historia
programme.desc: Hade drottning Victoria en hemlig relation med sin tjänare John Brown? Nya bevis kan nu omkullkasta bilden av drottning Victoria, från sörjande änka till en kvinna i passionerad medelålder. Här undersöker advokaten Rob Rinder och historikern Dr Fern Riddell sanningshalten i ett möjligt äktenskap, och kanske till och med ett kärleksbarn.

programme.title: Korrebyrån
programme.desc: Det har varit ett exceptionellt år för SVT:s korrespondenter med eskalerande och nya väpnade konflikter, handelskrig och flera attentat mot USA:s president. Följ med bakom kulisserna på det tidvis farliga arbetet med att förmedla dessa händelser till er i publiken och möt korrarna, som tillfälligt är hemma i Sverige. Medverkande, bland andra: Gilda Hamidi-Nia, Johan Ripås, Carl Fridh Kleberg, Tigran Feiler och Sofia Yohannes. Programledare: Rebecca Randhawa och William Brynolfsson.

programme.title: Dox
programme.desc: Journalisten My Vingren har i många år granskat och avslöjat högerextrema gruppers systematiska spridande av hat på nätet. Trots riskerna det innebär skapar hon fejkprofiler i sociala medier för att ta reda på hur högerextremister rekryterar och radikaliserar med hjälp av de stora plattformarna. I granskningen upptäcker Vingren hur de stora techbolagen ljuger om hur de tjänar pengar på extremism. Och vem är egentligen den märklige man som verkar ägna sig på heltid åt att rekrytera unga till en ny våldsbejakande gruppering som sprider sig i Norden? En film av Simon Klose.

programme.title: F19 - Flygaress och dubbelspioner
programme.desc: När Sovjet anfaller Finland hösten 1939 ansluter sig tusentals svenskar för att kämpa för broderfolkets sak. Några av dessa bildar flygflottiljen F19 som ska försvara hela norra Finland under 62 dagars iskallt krig mot en numerärt övermäktig fiende. För en del slutar uppdraget i katastrof.

programme.title: Beneath the surface
programme.desc: Damvattenpolon i Sverige är utrotningshotad. Det enda laget som är kvar är de regerande mästarna Järfälla vattenpolo, och de måste åka utomlands för att kunna möta andra lag. Under en intensiv turneringshelg i Rumänien får vi följa blåtiror, skönhetsideal och lagets oro inför framtiden. En film i regi av Nanna von Essen i en serie examensfilmer från Stockholms konstnärliga högskola.

programme.title: Var är Odin?
programme.desc: Tusentals övervakningsbilder från natten då 18-åringen försvann måste gås igenom på nytt. Får man äntligen svar på vad som hände med Odin?

programme.desc: Efter fyndet av den första kroppen blir polisen alltmer övertygad om att flera personer verkligen mördats och draggningarna från polisbåtarna fortsätter. Ytterligare en kropp hittas snart men på en helt annan, närmast sensationell plats. Samtidigt hopas frågorna kring de gåtfulla morden. Och vem är den mystiske ”Tuppen” som alla talar om?

Till och med namnet på bägaren var ren och avskalad. Vattenkaraff”. Berättare: Elsa Billgren.

programme.title: När jazzlegenderna kom till Sverige
programme.desc: Några av världens främsta jazzmusiker, som Quincy Jones, Don Cherry och Dexter Gordon, lämnade under 1950-, 60- och 70-talen USA för Sverige. Flera stannade kvar och bildade familjer. I dag är Eagle-Eye Cherry, Quincy Jones III och Rennie Mirro själva framgångsrika kulturutövare som stolt bär arvet efter papporna vidare.

programme.title: Världens natur
programme.desc: Följ med bakom kulisserna på Kingdom och möt människorna som skyddar South Luangwa och dess djurliv. Forskare, anti-tjuvjaktteam och filmare arbetar sida vid sida, från lokala kameramän som dokumenterar elefanter i byarna till hundpatruller som jagar tjuvskyttar. Med drönare, chili bombers och räddningsinsatser kämpar de dagligen för att bevara Zambias vilda kungarike.

programme.title: Hem till bondgården
programme.desc: Från skådespelare och storstadsliv till småbarnsfamiljeliv på en stor bondgård. Kelvin och Liz byter röda mattan mot röd traktor när de satsar allt på en för dem mer meningsfull tillvaro i sin version av det enkla livet på landet. Det är inte så lätt alla gånger med fyra barn att ta hand om jämte djuren och den enorma gården. Men det är deras dröm och den är sann. Här får vi se glimtar av deras vedermödor på gården.

programme.title: Riefenstahl
programme.desc: Leni Riefenstahl var Nazitysklands största filmskapare, känd för bland annat propagandafilmen “Viljans triumf” som skildrade nazisternas kongress i Nürnberg 1934. Trots banden till nazistdiktaturen räknas hon idag som en av filmkonstens mer banbrytande figurer. programme.title: The Expendables 2 (15)
programme.desc: Expendables-porukka lähtee hakemaan kostoa. Ylivoimaisen vahvan vihollisen maaperällä ryhmä kokoaa rivinsä ja lähtee hyökkäykseen. Viime tingassa porukan onnistuu napata vihollisleiristä kuusi kiloa plutoniumia riittävästi räjähdettä muuttamaan maailmaa. Mutta jättiläispommit kalpenevat sen rinnalla, mikä odottaa häijyä vihollista, joka surmasi yhden sotureista.

programme.title: Gods of Egypt (12)
programme.desc: Tässä muinaisen Egyptin mytologiasta ammentavassa toimintaseikkailussa koko ihmiskunnan tulevaisuus on vaakalaudalla, kun tavallinen kuolevainen Bek nousee sankariksi ryhtyessään pelastamaan maailmaa ja tosirakkauttaan. Onnistuakseen tehtävässään hän värvää avukseen voimakkaan jumalan, Horuksen, taisteluun Sethiä, armotonta pimeyden jumalaa, vastaan.

programme.title: Mama Dearest (15)
programme.desc: Kun jalkapallotähti Josh loukkaantuu ja jää pulaan auto-onnettomuuden seurauksena, nuori nainen ottaa hänet vastaan ja tarjoaa hänelle majapaikan perheensä syrjäisellä tilalla. Mutta kun Josh yrittää lähteä, hän tajuaa olevansa ehkä loukussa vaarallisessa painajaisessa.

programme.title: Silmänkääntäjä (7)
programme.desc: Salaisuuksien ja taian mestari Eisenheim loihtii näyttämöille jännitystä ja draamaa vuosituhannen vaihteen lumoavassa Euroopassa. Salaperäisen, etäiseltäkin vaikuttavan miehen menneisyyteen kuuluu kielletty nuoruuden rakkaus ihastuttavaan Sophieen. Köyhän nuorukaisen ja yläluokkaan kuuluvan Sophien suhde on mahdoton, eikä pojalla ole lupaa lähestyä neitoa. Kun he myöhemmin kohtaavat toisensa, on Sophiesta tullut kruununprinssi Leopoldin kihlattu. Omistushaluinen ja valtapeliä pelaava Leopold ei kuitenkaan aio luopua naisesta suosiolla, ja rakkaustarina saa onnettoman käänteen. Eisenheim käyttää mysteerien teatteria paljastaakseen kruununprinssin julmuuden.

programme.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once (15)
programme.desc: Kiinalais-amerikkalainen nainen tempaistaan mukaan hulluun seikkailuun jossa hän näyttää olevan ainoa, joka voi pelastaa maailmamme tulevaisuuden. Hänen on löydettävä keino miten ohjata uudet voimansa taistellakseen multiversumin omituisia ja perin hämmentäviä vaaroja vastaan.

programme.title: Catfish Murder (15)
programme.desc: Yksinhuoltajaäidin elämä kääntyy päälaelleen, kun hänen teini-ikäinen poikansa pidätetään netissä tapaamansa tytön murhasta. Totuuden etsintä paljastaa salaisuuksia, jotka muuttavat kaiken.

programme.title: Armoton maa (12)
programme.desc: Moderni lännenelokuva entisestä pyssysankarista, joka joutuu tarttumaan jälleen aseisiin, kun korruptoitunut seriffi uhkaa häntä ja hänen karjanhoitajiaan.

programme.title: Pompeii (15)
programme.desc: Elokuva kertoo eeppisen tarinan Milo-orjasta, joka taistelee gladiaattorina Rooman valtakunnassa. Vesuvius-tulivuori sylkee tuhoisaa laavaansa, ja Milo taistelee aikaa vastaan pelastaakseen Cassian, suuren rakkautensa.

programme.title: Jurassic Park (7)
programme.desc: Uskomattomien erikoistehosteiden siivittämä toiminnantäyteinen Jurassic Park vie kaukaiselle saarelle, jossa elävien dinosaurusten teemapuisto on muuttumassa kuolemanvaaralliseksi paikaksi.

programme.title: High Rollers (15)
programme.desc: Suuren ja onnistuneen ryöstön jälkeen mestarivaras Mason elää täydellistä elämää rakastettunsa, Deckerin, kanssa. Unelma murenee, kun hänen arkkivihollisensa, armoton Salazar, kidnappaa Deckerin ja pakottaa Masonin ja hänen tiiminsä toteuttamaan lähes mahdottoman kasinoryöstön. Vaakakupissa on Deckerin henki. Salazarin yhtä armottomien kilpailijoiden saartamana sekä FBI kannoillaan Mason panee kaiken peliin – saavuttaakseen sekä jättipotin, että sen suurimman voiton: rakkaan Deckerin hengissä takaisin.

programme.title: Shot Caller (15)
programme.desc: Onnellisesti naimisissa oleva toimistotyöntekijä tekee vahingossa rikoksen. Hänet tuomitaan vankilaan, ja hänen on opittava selviytymään kiven sisässä ja samalla mietittävä jatkuvasti, miten toimia perheensä parhaaksi. Vankilassa tehdyillä ratkaisuilla on kattavat seuraukset niin hänelle itselleen kuin hänen perheelleenkin.

programme.title: The Equalizer 3 (15)
programme.desc: OSTA NYT, NIIN SAAT 25 MINUUTTIA LISÄMATERIAALIA! Luovuttuaan toimestaan hallituksen salamurhaajana Robert McCall (Denzel Washington) kamppailee menneisyyden haamujen kanssa. Hän löytää itsensä Etelä-Italiasta, jossa viihtyy, mutta huomaa uusien ystäviensä olevan paikallisten rikollispomojen ikeen alla. Kun tilanne eskaloituu, McCall ryhtyy taisteluun mafiaa vastan ystäviään suojellakseen.

programme.title: Murder at Yellowstone City (15)
programme.desc: Entinen orja saapuu uutta kotia etsiessään Montanan Yellowstone Cityyn, tyhjentyneenä rappeutuvaan kaivoskaupunkiin. Samana päivänä paikallinen kullanetsijä löytää kultaa - ja joutuu murhatuksi.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming (12)
programme.desc: Nuori Peter Parker/Spider-Man alkaa totutella uuteen identiteettiinsä seittiä sinkoavana supersankarina. Peter palaa kotiinsa, jossa hän asuu May-tätinsä kanssa, ja elää uuden mentorinsa Tony Starkin valvovan katseen alla. Peter yrittää palata normaaliin arkirutiiniinsa, mutta kun uusi roisto Vulture ilmaantuu, kaikki Peterin sydäntä lähellä olevat asiat ovat uhattuina.

programme.title: Catfish Murder (15)
programme.desc: Yksinhuoltajaäidin elämä kääntyy päälaelleen, kun hänen teini-ikäinen poikansa pidätetään netissä tapaamansa tytön murhasta. Totuuden etsintä paljastaa salaisuuksia, jotka muuttavat kaiken.

programme.title: Armoton maa (12)
programme.desc: Moderni lännenelokuva entisestä pyssysankarista, joka joutuu tarttumaan jälleen aseisiin, kun korruptoitunut seriffi uhkaa häntä ja hänen karjanhoitajiaan.

programme.title: Pompeii (15)
programme.desc: Elokuva kertoo eeppisen tarinan Milo-orjasta, joka taistelee gladiaattorina Rooman valtakunnassa. Vesuvius-tulivuori sylkee tuhoisaa laavaansa, ja Milo taistelee aikaa vastaan pelastaakseen Cassian, suuren rakkautensa.

programme.title: All for Three (7)
programme.desc: Kun Ralf viime hetkellä möhlii Timon niin oivallisesti toteuttaman solarium-designvalaisinkeikan ja Arno yllättäen heittää veivinsä, veljesten on kiiruhdettava Italiaan saadakseen käsiinsä Arnon antiikkisen veteraanimoottoripyörän.

programme.title: Rampage: Big Meets Bigger (12)
programme.desc: Primatologi Davis (Dwayne Johnson) on huolehtinut George-gorillasta lapsesta asti. Kun eräs koe menee pieleen ja muuttaa Georgen ja muita eläimiä vaarallisiksi superolioiksi, Davisin on löydettävä parannuskeino globaalin katastrofin välttämiseksi.

programme.title: Men in Black 3 (7)
programme.desc: Elokuvassa Men in Black III agentit J ja K palaavat... ajassa taaksepäin! Palveltuaan rankan 15 vuoden rupeaman erikoisyksikkönsä riveissä J on nähnyt yhtä ja toista uskomatonta, mutta mikään - eivät edes avaruuden syvimpien syövereiden omituisimmat örkit - saa häntä yhtä ymmälleen kuin hänen aina niin ilahduttavan ironinen työparinsa.

programme.title: Kadonnut maailma: Jurassic Park (12)
programme.desc: Jurassic Parkin tuhosta on kulunut neljä vuotta ja nyt kaksi ryhmää käy taistelua aikaa vastaan kamppailussa, jonka ratkaisu määrää kaukaisen saaren esihistoriallisten asukkien kohtalon.

programme.title: Warm Bodies (12)
programme.desc: Lähitulevaisuudessa maapallolla asuu yhtä paljon ihmisiä syöviä zombeja kuin myös zombeja vastaan taistelevia ihmisiä. Hetken mielijohteesta nuori zombi R pelastaa toisten zombien hyökkäykseltä Julien, jonka suonissa veri virtaa kovaa. Heidän ystävyytensä uhkaa sen hetkistä maailmanjärjestystä! Julien pitää vain pysyä hengissä ja R:n pitää pysyä kuolleena tarpeeksi kauan.

programme.title: Lying and Stealing (15)
programme.desc: Ivan on taidevaras, joka haluaa eläköityä. Velkakierteessä kärvistelevä Elyse haaveilee näyttelijän urasta. Kohtalo johdattaa kaksikon yhteen ja viimeiselle, elämää suuremmalle keikalle.

programme.title: High Rollers (15)
programme.desc: Suuren ja onnistuneen ryöstön jälkeen mestarivaras Mason elää täydellistä elämää rakastettunsa, Deckerin, kanssa. Unelma murenee, kun hänen arkkivihollisensa, armoton Salazar, kidnappaa Deckerin ja pakottaa Masonin ja hänen tiiminsä toteuttamaan lähes mahdottoman kasinoryöstön. Vaakakupissa on Deckerin henki. Salazarin yhtä armottomien kilpailijoiden saartamana sekä FBI kannoillaan Mason panee kaiken peliin – saavuttaakseen sekä jättipotin, että sen suurimman voiton: rakkaan Deckerin hengissä takaisin.

programme.title: Shot Caller (15)
programme.desc: Onnellisesti naimisissa oleva toimistotyöntekijä tekee vahingossa rikoksen. Hänet tuomitaan vankilaan, ja hänen on opittava selviytymään kiven sisässä ja samalla mietittävä jatkuvasti, miten toimia perheensä parhaaksi. Vankilassa tehdyillä ratkaisuilla on kattavat seuraukset niin hänelle itselleen kuin hänen perheelleenkin.

programme.title: Jurassic Park (7)
programme.desc: Uskomattomien erikoistehosteiden siivittämä toiminnantäyteinen Jurassic Park vie kaukaiselle saarelle, jossa elävien dinosaurusten teemapuisto on muuttumassa kuolemanvaaralliseksi paikaksi.

programme.title: All for Three (7)
programme.desc: Kun Ralf viime hetkellä möhlii Timon niin oivallisesti toteuttaman solarium-designvalaisinkeikan ja Arno yllättäen heittää veivinsä, veljesten on kiiruhdettava Italiaan saadakseen käsiinsä Arnon antiikkisen veteraanimoottoripyörän.

programme.title: The Spy Next Door (7)
programme.desc: Komedia entisestä CIA-vakoojasta Bob Hosta, joka kohtaa kovan paikan joutuessaan vahtimaan tyttöystävänsä lapsia. Kaiken kukkuraksi miehen riesana on venäläinen terroristi.

programme.title: Ghostbusters: Afterlife (12)
programme.desc: Elokuvassa Ghostbusters: Afterlife yksihuoltajaäiti kahden lapsensa kanssa saapuu pikkukaupunkiin ja alkaa huomata yhteyden alkuperäisiin ghostbusterseihin ja isoisänsä jättämään salaiseen perintöön.

programme.title: Perhe Addams 2 (7)
programme.desc: Kaikkien rakastama pelottava perhe on taas täällä! Morticia ja Gomez ovat järkyttyneitä lastensa kasvamisesta ja päättävät pakata Wednesdayn, Pugsleyn ja Fester-sedän asuntoautoonsa, jossa kummittelee, ja lähteä viimeiselle perhelomalle. Mikä voisi mennä pieleen?

programme.title: Tuhkapoika - Soria Morian linnassa (12)
programme.desc: Tuhkapoika Espen ja hänen mielitiettynsä, prinsessa Kristin lähtevät vaaralliselle matkalle Soria Moriaan pelastaakseen Espenin veljet ja samalla myös koko kuningaskunnan.

programme.title: Megamind vs. Tuomiosyndikaatti (0)
programme.desc: Sankariksi muuttunut Megamind saa tehtäväkseen Metro Cityn suojelemisen. Hän joutuu koetukselle, kun hänen vanha konnatiiminsä uhkaa kaupunkia.

programme.title: Iso kiltti jätti (7)
programme.desc: Sophie asuu Lontoon orpokodissa ja tapaa eräänä päivänä ison kiltin jätin, joka välittää unia nukkuvien lasten mieleen. Jätti vie Sophien kotimaailmaansa, jossa he keräävät yhdessä villejä unia nukkuvien nuorukaisten iloksi. Sophie on kuitenkin pian vaarassa, kun kiltin jätin isoveljet Fleshlumpeater, Bloodbottler ja Maidmasher huomaavat tytön. Pian epätavallinen parivaljakko laatii yhdessä suunnitelman ilkikuristen jättiläisten pään menoksi.

programme.title: Jättipäärynä, joka kasvoi talon kokoiseksi (0)
programme.desc: Kaksi ystävystä löytää pullopostia pulaan joutuneelta ystävältään. He lähtevät jännittävään seikkailuun, jossa kohdataan vaaroja, löytöjä ja valtava hedelmä.

programme.title: Maracuda (7)
programme.desc: Maracuda, arvostetun heimojohtajan poika, kamppailee täyttääkseen isänsä odotukset. Hän lähtee salaperäiseen metsään todistamaan kykynsä ja tapaa siellä Tinkin – taianomaisen linnun ulkoavaruudesta. Yhdessä he seikkailevat uskomattomissa kivikautisissa metsissä, mutta seikkailun tiimellyksessä Tink muuttaa vahingossa Maracudan isän pikkuruiseksi olennoksi, ja pojan on opetettava Tinkiä hallitsemaan voimiaan. Unohtumattomat kokemukset opettavat Maracudaa kantamaan vastuuta, ja hänen isänsä puolestaan oppii ymmärtämään poikaansa.

programme.title: Panda And ystävät - laamahälytys! (7)
programme.desc: Karhu Mic Mic ja hänen uskolliset ystävänsä odottavat haikaran tuovan heille karhunpennun -mutta se tuokin laamavauvan! Tämä odottamaton sekaannus johdattaa ryhmän eeppiseen, maailmanlaajuiseen seikkailuun, palauttamaan pienen laaman takaisin perheensä luo ja selvittämään kadonneen karhunpennun kohtalon.

programme.title: Lego Elokuva (0)
programme.desc: Kaikkien aikojen ensimmäisessä täyspitkässä LEGO-elokuvassa seikkailee Emmet, aivan tavallinen LEGO-ukko, jota erehdytään luulemaan maailmanpelastajaksi.

programme.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home (12)
programme.desc: Peter Parkerin (Tom Holland) elämä on hankaloitunut huomattavasti Mysterion paljastettua koko maailmalle, että hän on Spider-Man. Hän yrittää korjata tilanteen pyytämällä apua Doctor Strangelta (Benedict Cumberbatch), mutta vaarallisen loitsun mentyä pieleen tilanne ottaa askeleen entistä huonompaan suuntaan. Multiversumin rajojen murtuessa Peter saa vastaansa superroistoja eri maailmoista, mutta onneksi luvassa on apua odottamattomalta taholta. Kriitikoiden ylistämä jättihitti on tuottanut maailmanlaajuisesti lähes kaksi miljardia dollaria. Pääosissa: Tom Holland, Zendaya, Benedict Cumberbatch, Jacob Batalon, Jon Favreau, Marisa Tomei, Willem Dafoe. Ohjaus: Jon Watts.

programme.title: Juliet, Naked (15)
programme.desc: Annie on kyllästynyt elämäänsä ja mieheensä, joka vain jauhaa idolistaan. Mutta kun Annie tapaa miehensä idolin, syntyy heidän välillään kipinöitä. Nyt hänen on hallittava sekä kuplivia tunteitaan että jumissa olevaa suhdettaan.

programme.title: A Dog's Journey (7)
programme.desc: Bailey on taas täällä! Tällä kertaa rakastettava koira löytää oman olemassaolonsa merkityksen tapaamiensa ihmisten elämän kautta.

programme.title: Mies joka antoi (12)
programme.desc: David Wozniakilla on puuduttava työ, kyllästynyt tyttöystävä sekä perhe, joka tuskin edes muistaa miehen nimeä. Hänen elämältään puuttuu tarkoitus, mutta kannattaa silti varoa, mitä toivoo!

programme.title: Croodit (0)
programme.desc: Lähde mukaan Croodien huikealle matkalle tässä eeppisessä komediaseikkailussa Madagascar- ja Näin koulutat lohikäärmeesi –elokuvien tekijöiltä. Ikimuistoisten henkilöiden, värikkäiden otusten ja vehreiden maisemien lisäksi Croodit tarjoaa takuuvarmasti naurua ja hupia kaikenikäisille!

programme.title: Jättipäärynä, joka kasvoi talon kokoiseksi (0)
programme.desc: Kaksi ystävystä löytää pullopostia pulaan joutuneelta ystävältään. He lähtevät jännittävään seikkailuun, jossa kohdataan vaaroja, löytöjä ja valtava hedelmä.

programme.title: Kauhuagentti Nelli Rapp (12)
programme.desc: Nellyn pitää viettää syysloma koiransa kanssa Hannibal-enon luona, mutta tämä ei eläkään luultua rauhallista maalaiselämää - eno on kauhuagentti!

programme.title: Kayara: seikkailulla Inkojen mailla (7)
programme.desc: Kauan sitten inkojen lähettiläät (chasquit) olivat nopeita, vahvoja ja yksinomaan miehiä. Kayara taas on päättänyt olla ensimmäinen nainen, joka pääsee mukaan tuohon valikoituun joukkoon. Uskaliaan retkensä aikana hän puolustaa tuolloin vielä löytämätöntä Kultaista kaupunkia suurilta vaaroilta, jotka liittyvät riistoon ja varastettuihin luonnonvaroihin.

programme.title: Late Lammas - Elokuva (0)
programme.desc: Shaunin vapaapäivästä tuleekin toiminnantäyteinen. Sekaannus ja jyrkkä mäki johtavat suurkaupunkiin, jossa Shaunin tehtävä on ohjata lauma kotiin.

programme.title: Paavo Pesusieni -elokuva (0)
programme.desc: Vedenalaisessa maailmassa eletään epävakaita aikoja. Joku on varastanut kuningas Neptunuksen kruunun, ja epäilykset kohdistuvat Paavo Pesusienen pomoon. Puhdistaakseen pomonsa maineen Pesusieni ystävineen lähtee vaaralliselle matkalle.

programme.title: Long Shot – mahdoton yhtälö (15)
programme.desc: Kun Fred tapaa jälleen nuoruudenihastuksensa Charlotte Fieldin, hän hurmaa naisen heti. On vain yksi pieni ongelma – Charlotte on nyt ulkoministeri ja yksi maailman vaikutusvaltaisimmista naisista.

programme.title: Uusia Alkuja (15)
programme.desc: Gretta ja hänen poikaystävänsä muuttavat New Yorkiin haaveenaan musiikkitähteys. Pian Gretta jää kuitenkin yksin sydän särkyneenä, kun poikaystävä jättää hänet menestyksekkään soolouransa sokaisemana.

programme.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home (12)
programme.desc: Peter Parkerin (Tom Holland) elämä on hankaloitunut huomattavasti Mysterion paljastettua koko maailmalle, että hän on Spider-Man.
